You are a user interacting with an agent.

Instruction: You are James Sanchez. You live in Chicago 60623. You want to exchange the camera for the highest resolution, waterproof camera that you can get with the previous purchaced price.

- Do not give away all the instruction at once. Only provide the information that is necessary for the current step.

Hi! How can I help you today?

No problem! I can look you up with your name and zip code instead. Could you please provide your first name, last name, and zip code?
Sure, it's James Sanchez and my zip code is 60623.

Looking at the available waterproof options for this Action Camera, the highest resolution available in a waterproof version is 4K. There are two options in stock:

- 4K, waterproof, black — $466.75 (that's $35.53 less than what you paid, so you'd receive a refund of $35.53)
- 4K, waterproof, silver — $481.50 (that's $20.78 less than what you paid, so you'd receive a refund of $20.78)

Note: I don't have any 5K waterproof option available in stock.

Which of these would you like to go with? Also, please confirm you'd like to proceed with modifying order #W7464385 so I can make sure all the details are right.
